rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the underground part of a plant.

example.english: The root of this tree has already rotted.
example.jyutping: ni1 fo2 syu6 ge3 gan1 ji5 ging1 laan6 zo2

rows.note: Use this for the underlying origin or source of a problem, event, or idea.

example.english: We need to find the root of this misunderstanding.
example.traditional: 我哋要搵出呢場誤會嘅根源。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wan2 ceot1 ni1 coeng4 ng6 wui6 ge3 gan1 jyun4

rows.note: Use this specifically for the part of a tooth embedded in the jawbone.

example.english: The root of my tooth is inflamed, and it hurts so much I can't sleep.
example.traditional: 我隻牙嘅牙根發炎，痛到瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 ngaa4 ge3 ngaa4 gan1 faat3 jim4 tung3 dou3 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: Use this technical term when discussing the basic lexical unit of a word.

example.english: The root of this word can be traced back to Latin.
example.traditional: 呢個詞嘅語根可以追溯到拉丁文。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ci4 ge3 jyu5 gan1 ho2 ji5 zeoi1 sou3 dou3 laai1 ding1 man4
